name: agent-sphere-desktop
description: AgentSphere desktop client and local agent runtime connector

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ui,electron "npm --prefix ../agent-sphere-ui run dev" "npm run build:main && cross-env AS_DEV_URL=http://localhost:8000 AS_DEFAULT_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:8080 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run build:ui && electron-builder --linux
